newsitem.title: USA: Reddi Brake Sept same warehouse sales up.
newsitem.headline: Reddi Brake Sept same warehouse sales up.

text.p: Reddi Brake Supply Corp said Thursday that same warehouse net sales for September 1996 increased 9.95 percent,to $4,721,981, compared to $4,294,770 in September 1995.

The company also reported that Reddi Brake warehouses recorded September 1996 net sales of $5,084,765, a 4.64 percent increase over the $4,859,066 recorded for all warehouses in September, 1995. In September, 1995 the company operated a total of 99 warehouses.
